title: Sustainable growth for Caledon
excerpt: Development and the environment don't have to be at odds. Here is how I think about growing Caledon responsibly.
author: Manjit Bhondhi
content:
Caledon and the Peel Region have changed in remarkable ways over the years I have lived and worked here.

## Development with care

While enabling development, we must consider the impact our decisions have on our environment and our communities.

The sustainable path forward is the only path that will benefit generations to come.

## What this means locally

- Growth that respects existing neighbourhoods
- Protecting the natural areas that make Caledon special
- Decisions made with residents, not around them

title: Twenty years in business: what it teaches about public service
excerpt: From a convention centre to a mortgage brokerage, running local businesses shaped how I listen and decide.
author: Manjit Bhondhi
content:
I have been a mortgage broker for over 20 years, and the principal of several businesses across the Peel Region.

I have owned and operated a convention centre, a restaurant and stores, in addition to the brokerage I continue to run today.

## Lessons that carry over

Running a business means answering to the people you serve every day. That habit is the one I want to bring to Regional Council.
